config.notes: Equity desks become viable here. The overnight desk is the flagship (walk-forward Sharpe 0.83) and monthly-rebalanced cross-sectional momentum adds a low-turnover second stream. No shorting: under $2,000 an Alpaca account is limited-margin and cannot short at all.

notes: Paper unless the account is explicitly armed. Walk-forward figures are out-of-sample with fixed parameters; a desk only trades when its verdict is validated.
